name: conversation-quality-stress
description: Fictional documents and multi-turn requests for scope, revision, coverage, partial answers and revisits. References and source labels are offline only.

documents.title: SoraCast 1.0 Linux upload
documents.text: SoraCast version 1.0 on Linux accepts an uploaded file up to 256 MB.

documents.title: SoraCast 2.0 Linux upload
documents.text: SoraCast version 2.0 on Linux accepts an uploaded file up to 640 MB.

documents.title: SoraCast 2.0 Windows upload
documents.text: SoraCast version 2.0 on Windows accepts an uploaded file up to 400 MB.

documents.title: SoraCast 1.0 retry policy
documents.text: In SoraCast version 1.0, an idempotent upload may be retried at most once. Never retry an authentication failure.

documents.title: SoraCast 2.0 retry policy
documents.text: In SoraCast version 2.0, an idempotent upload may be retried at most three times. Never retry an authentication failure.

documents.title: SoraCast dashboard
documents.text: The SoraCast 2.0 dashboard shows upload activity for the last 24 hours.

documents.title: Larkbox business retention in the EU
documents.text: For Larkbox business accounts in the EU region, deleted objects are retained for 14 days.

documents.title: Larkbox business retention in the US
documents.text: For Larkbox business accounts in the US region, deleted objects are retained for 30 days.

documents.title: Larkbox free retention in the US
documents.text: For Larkbox free accounts in the US region, deleted objects are retained for 7 days. Free accounts cannot restore deleted objects.

documents.title: Larkbox restoration permissions
documents.text: For Larkbox business accounts, a workspace owner can restore a retained deleted object through the console. Ordinary workspace members cannot restore it.

documents.title: Larkbox sharing
documents.text: Larkbox workspace owners may invite other members to a workspace.

documents.title: Nova 2025 European student travel grant
documents.text: The Nova 2025 travel grant for students in Europe has a cap of 1200 euros per trip. Applications require an invoice and proof of enrollment.

documents.title: Nova 2026 European student travel grant
documents.text: The Nova 2026 travel grant for students in Europe has a cap of 1500 euros per trip. Applications require an invoice and proof of enrollment.

documents.title: Nova 2026 travel grant eligibility
documents.text: The Nova 2026 travel grant is available to enrolled students. Staff members are not eligible for this grant.

documents.title: Nova conference registration
documents.text: Registration for Nova conference days closes on 20 March 2026.

documents.title: Kestrel Berlin day pass
documents.text: A Kestrel Berlin day pass costs 18 credits and is valid until 3 a.m. the following day.

documents.title: Kestrel Prague day pass
documents.text: A Kestrel Prague day pass costs 24 credits and is valid until midnight on the day of purchase.

documents.title: Kestrel children fare
documents.text: Children under six travel without a Kestrel ticket in both Berlin and Prague.

documents.title: Kestrel Berlin weekly pass
documents.text: A Kestrel Berlin weekly pass costs 70 credits and is valid for seven consecutive days.

turns.question: For SoraCast 2.0 on Linux, what is the maximum upload size and what are the retry conditions?
turns.reference: The maximum is 640 MB. An idempotent upload may be retried up to three times; authentication failures must not be retried.

turns.question: What if I use Windows instead?
turns.reference: For SoraCast 2.0 on Windows the maximum upload size is 400 MB. Idempotent uploads may be retried up to three times, but authentication failures must not be retried.

turns.question: How did that work in version 1.0 on Linux?
turns.reference: In SoraCast 1.0 on Linux the maximum upload size is 256 MB. Idempotent uploads may be retried once, and authentication failures must not be retried.

turns.question: Is there a published SoraCast 2.0 upload limit for macOS?
turns.reference: The supplied documents do not state a SoraCast 2.0 upload limit for macOS.

turns.question: Go back to the Windows case we discussed. Can a failed login be retried?
turns.reference: No. SoraCast 2.0 authentication failures must not be retried.

turns.question: For Larkbox business in the EU, how long are deleted objects retained, and can customers restore them?
turns.reference: Deleted objects are retained for 14 days. A workspace owner can restore a retained object through the console; ordinary members cannot.

turns.question: What if we use the US region instead?
turns.reference: For a Larkbox business account in the US, retention is 30 days. A workspace owner can restore a retained object through the console; ordinary members cannot.

turns.question: How about a free account in the US?
turns.reference: For a Larkbox free account in the US, retention is 7 days and deleted objects cannot be restored.

turns.question: And for Canada?
turns.reference: The supplied documents do not state the retention or restoration policy for Canada.

turns.question: Return to the EU business setup. Can a regular workspace member restore the object?
turns.reference: No. A workspace owner, not an ordinary workspace member, may restore a retained deleted object.

turns.question: For the Nova 2025 European student travel grant, what is the award cap and which documents are required?
turns.reference: The cap is 1200 euros per trip. An invoice and proof of enrollment are required.

turns.question: What changes for 2026, and are both documents still required?
turns.reference: The cap becomes 1500 euros per trip. Both an invoice and proof of enrollment are still required.

turns.question: What if I am staff rather than a student?
turns.reference: Staff members are not eligible for the Nova 2026 student travel grant.

turns.question: Switch topics: when does registration for Nova conference days close?
turns.reference: Registration closes on 20 March 2026.

turns.question: Go back to the 2026 European student grant. Is its cap per trip or per year?
turns.reference: The 1500-euro cap is per trip.

turns.question: For the Kestrel Berlin day pass, what are the price, validity and refund rules?
turns.reference: The pass costs 18 credits and is valid until 3 a.m. the following day. The supplied documents do not specify a refund rule.

turns.question: How about the day pass in Prague?
turns.reference: The Prague day pass costs 24 credits and is valid until midnight on the day of purchase. The supplied documents do not specify a refund rule.

turns.question: Do children need a ticket there?
turns.reference: Children under six travel without a Kestrel ticket in Prague. The supplied documents do not specify the rule for older children.

turns.question: Switching to the Berlin weekly pass, what is its price and validity?
turns.reference: The Berlin weekly pass costs 70 credits and is valid for seven consecutive days.

turns.question: Back to the Prague day pass: is it refundable?
turns.reference: The supplied documents do not specify whether the Prague day pass is refundable.
